Li et al. concluded that fatigue or even fracture of the clips may threaten the safety of train operation, which is reflected in the decrease of fastener tightening force provided by the elastic clips, leading to the inability of the fastener to provide a stable connection between the rail and the track slab and the resultant dynamic instability of the system.

The empirical fitting curve is Sc = 1580 + 162.8ΔXf (29) where Sc(MPa) is the von Mises stress of the hazardous area of the WJ-8 type fastener clip; ΔXf is the relative displacement between the rail and the track slab in the same vertical reference frame, which can be calculated by the VT dynamic interaction model.
